verdict.rationale: Consensus documents Deep Search as a feature that produces comprehensive literature reviews "in minutes." It also synthesizes evidence with citations and offers a visual Consensus Meter, so it does generate a report-like synthesis. However, nothing in the evidence describes how that output is structured or whether it can be shared. Missing for 10: documented section structure, tables in the output, an explicit summary section, sharing/export to stakeholders, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of report quality.
